fact: The Ministry of Basic and Senior Secondary Education developed EDITH, an AI system for ministry officials' information-management tasks, by March 2026, and is preparing handover to its IT Department from pilot status.

EdTech Hub reports that the Ministry of Education's eight-person delivery team uses an internal WhatsApp chatbot (retrieval pipeline with GPT-4) to get figures such as teacher and pupil numbers and exam results for reports, and that the team uses it most days according to the logs.
system: internal WhatsApp chatbot for the Ministry of Education delivery team

fact: The Directorate of Science, Technology and Innovation says it launched the EDSA WhatsApp chatbot with the electricity authority and Ministry of Energy, live nationwide for citizens to report faults and track tickets.
